planets.name: K2-128 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-128 with a 5.68-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-128 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-128. Its orbit and size follow Dressing et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
